headline.purpose: Authentication, status, and workspace page titles.

label.purpose: Form fields and concise control descriptors.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Button color and border feedback; reduced-motion preferences suppress transitions.

motion.name: scroll-behavior
motion.purpose: In-page target navigation; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a task surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.8rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.58rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.42rem; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); color: #fff; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter bordered action for adjacent or cancel paths.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.8rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.58rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid #b7c0c2; border-radius: 0.42rem; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #7e8b90; background: #f1f2ef; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: A labeled text or selection control.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="school-email">School email</label><input class="ds-field-input" id="school-email" type="email" autocomplete="username">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.38rem; color: var(--ink); font: 680 0.86rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.8rem; padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #bac2c3; border-radius: 0.42rem; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #76858c; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid rgb(146 43 55 / 22%); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Institutional Workspace Rail and Navigation
components.description: A persistent desktop rail groups school identity and role-filtered destinations; mobile uses a compact header and visible two-column links.
components.css: .ds-workspace-frame { display: grid; min-height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: 16.25rem minmax(0, 1fr); background: var(--page); } .ds-rail { position: sticky; top: 0; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 1.25rem; height: 100vh; padding: 1.5rem 1rem; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; } .ds-rail nav { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-rail a { display: flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; color: #d9e0e1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail a:hover { background: #29373d; color: #fff; } .ds-rail a[aria-current="page"] { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--accent); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-workspace-frame { display: block; } .ds-rail { position: static; height: auto; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; } .ds-rail nav { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

components.name: Summary Strip
components.description: Existing role summary measures in a high-contrast compact band.
components.css: .ds-summary { padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.9rem; background: #26363c; color: #fff; } .ds-summary dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; } .ds-summary dl > div { min-width: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; border-right: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 17%); } .ds-summary dl > div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-summary dt { color: #d4dcde; font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-summary dd { margin: 0.35rem 0 0; color: #fff; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 740; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: A light work surface groups related forms, review context, or data.
components.css: .ds-work-panel { padding: 1.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.9rem; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); } .ds-work-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.45rem; color: var(--ink); font: 730 1.16rem/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-work-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 0.96rem/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: ARKTIESIIS is an institutional records workspace with an editorial frame: a persistent desktop ink rail, a clearly marked current location, and quiet, legible work surfaces. The public home and sign-in views keep their masthead and pair institutional context with the unchanged campus photograph; authenticated pages place a spacious warm-paper work canvas beside the rail. Role dashboards use distinct structures for account and audit work, registrar destinations, student records, and finance search or transaction review. Crimson marks the primary action, focus, current location, and error. Wording describes current product behavior accurately, including the advisory role and limits of OCR.
keyCharacteristics: A persistent deep ink desktop rail carries the seal, institution and branch wording, role, sign-out action, and current-location state; mobile uses a compact header with all role links visible.
Public and authentication views use a dark context panel beside the authentic campus photograph or focused form.
Role dashboards lead from their real summary into distinct account, audit, registrar-task, student-record, or finance work structures.
Typography, rules, and restrained crimson provide hierarchy without decorative shadows or animation.

rules.name: The Ink Frame Rule
rules.body: Use the dark institutional frame to orient visitors and workspace users; let the working content stay on light, readable surfaces.

rules.name: The One Crimson Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep crimson to actions, current-location emphasis, focus, and errors. Do not turn it into a second large page background.

rules.name: The Surface-by-Task Rule
rules.body: Reserve the dark ink field for institutional context and summaries; keep active data entry, reading, and decision tasks on light surfaces.

dos: Do preserve the official seal and supplied campus photograph as provided.
Do preserve existing role destinations, route actions, field names, CSRF fields, EJS escaping, and server authorization.
Do keep forms and operational tables on light surfaces within the ink institutional frame.
Do keep existing OCR wording advisory; staff review remains part of document acceptance.
Do maintain visible keyboard focus and layouts usable at 320px.
donts: Don't invent role navigation, counts, operational capabilities, or document-verification claims.
Don't add decorative gradients, shadows, external fonts, or replacement campus imagery.
Don't use the ink field as the background for dense forms or long data tables.
Don't shrink labels below comfortable reading size to force narrow layouts; reflow the content instead.
